description: Check a UK limited company on its public Companies House record and show it as a card: when its accounts, confirmation statement and Corporation Tax are due, whether anything is overdue or was filed late, and a score out of 100 with the reasons. Needs no account. Use it whenever someone asks about a UK company's deadlines or standing, for example "when is my confirmation statement due", "are my accounts overdue", "is this company in good standing" or "check my company". Find the number by name with lookup_company first.

company.description: Which company to read, by name or id, when the account has more than one (see list_companies). Leave it out to use the only company, or the default.

name: check_company
title: Check A UK Company
